newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-AUXERRE GOALKEEPER OUT FOR SIX WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUXERRE GOALKEEPER OUT FOR SIX WEEKS.

text.p: Auxerre's goalkeeper Lionel Charbonnier will be out for action for six weeks after pulling a thigh muscle during Wednesday's European Cup Champions' League match against Ajax Amsterdam, the team doctor said.
He will be replaced by second-choice keeper Fabien Cool.
Striker Bernard Diomede, who scored Auxerre's first goal in their 2-1 win over Ajax, is also likely to miss his team's league match against Bastia on Saturday with a shoulder injury.
